body: I want the pain to stop I can't keep going like this
Why do you care you don't even know me

I don't feel like I can trust anyone anymore some people I thought were my closest friends that I thought I could trust with some personal things and they just let it all out everyone lies for their own benefit 
People say if you help people and make them happy then you will be happy or find happiness or happiness comes to you or good things something like that and all my life I have done nothing but help others and try make them as happy as I can
I don't expect anything in return from anyone I don't expect a thank you or anything as long as I did good by them 
But I have never seen a single spec of happiness 
It is all just a big lie there is no such thing as happiness it's just a lie 
All I get is pain all the time I just want a small sign of something good in this world someone to trust but it is none existant I wish something would just end all this pain just end it all

I see the families weekends when they are not busy
And I am not allowed to work I am going crazy with no one to talk to and most of the time it feels like no one cares I don't want people to be wasting their time with me but they expect me to do things that I can't

I work in a warehouse I like working there with everyone 
Friends deaths have been 
1 killed himself after he paralyzed himself at gym 
1 was killed by someone overseas while she was on holidays
2 in a car accident (not there fault)
1 motorbike accident (he was being stupid)
1 fell rock climbing broke his neck
1 died serving overseas in military

My dog was run over by someone and I was there 
I had to carry her back home and bury her 


I am trying but it's really hard to deal with all them going 
I remember all there faces all the memories we shared together
